ev: ولا اعلم خلافا بين أهل الأداء
items.note: Reading aloud (jahr) or quietly (ikhfā') the isti'adha. The book says the reciters agree on the jahr, then gives these reports; it says nothing is stated for the rest. The reports for Nāfiʿ and Abū ʿAmr come through named students, not through Warsh, Qālūn, al-Dūrī or al-Sūsī.

unresolved.reason: Sulaym's report that Ḥamza read it aloud only at the start of the Fātiḥa and quietly after, given on the word of 'Khalaf from him'; the reader is a pronoun, so no transmitter is assigned

ev: السكت بين السورتين من غير قطع

forms.desc: يبسملون بين كل سورتين في جميع القرآن
السكت بين السورتين من غير قطع

items.note: The basmala between two suras. By agreement there is none between al-Anfāl and Barāʾa. The book says the rest do not say it between suras, and gives Ḥamza and Khalaf the connection of the two suras and Warsh, Abū ʿAmr, Ibn ʿĀmir and Yaʿqūb the pause without a cut.

skipped.why: chain of transmission (isnad) that closes the previous chapter
the wording of the isti'adha and its scriptural support; one form given for all, no difference among readers
the view of Ibn Mujahid, who is not one of the ten
the author's own routes of reading, which he says go beyond the routes of the book
a practice of some teachers that the book says has no report from the readers

ev: ولا خلاف في التسمية في أول فاتحة
skipped.why: agreement of all readers, not a difference
agreement of all readers on beginning at a part, and the closing prayer
